source_records.next_action: Identify item-level works and credits; create specimen records only after direct visual inspection.

source_records.evidence: 24 photographic prints dated 1977–1980 described in the Archives of American Art collection search.
source_records.next_action: Open each item record and capture stable identifiers, credits, dates and rights.

source_records.title: Smithsonian — Chalfant series item search

source_records.title: Bronx Museum — Henry Chalfant: Art vs. Transit, 1977–1987
source_records.evidence: Museum exhibition page documents Chalfant's archive and names multiple writers represented in the work.
source_records.next_action: Use named writers as search keys into credited archive items.

source_records.title: Letterform Archive — An Undercover Look at its Graffiti Collection
source_records.evidence: Article describes a graffiti zine collection and writer/type-designer perspective on alphabet invention and personal styles.
source_records.next_action: Identify zine titles and catalogue records; distinguish editorial images from reusable assets.

source_records.title: Museum of the City of New York — City as Canvas background guide
source_records.evidence: Historical account discusses progression from tags to pieces, bubble lettering, light/shadow and colour complexity.
source_records.next_action: Use for historical context only; do not extract images for the public repo.

source_records.title: Mucem — Tagging and Graffiti: Illegal Art at the Museum
source_records.evidence: Museum collection policy describes a range of lettering styles and varied material forms.
source_records.next_action: Explore collection objects and item-level credits.

source_records.title: MoMA — Evan Roth, Graffiti Taxonomy: New York (2011)
source_records.evidence: MoMA describes comparative taxonomies of graffiti tags, letters, regional styles, commonalities and deviations.
source_records.next_action: Use as a methodological reference for comparing repeated glyphs across writers.

source_records.title: Urban Nation — SEEN: Black Books Vol. 3 review
source_records.evidence: Review identifies throw-ups, blockbusters and whole-car work within SEEN's documented practice.
source_records.next_action: Use bibliographic reference to locate the book; do not treat review as individual specimen.

source_records.title: Google Arts & Culture — Moving Murals: Henry Chalfant & Martha Cooper's All City Graffiti Archive
source_records.evidence: Curated story credits photographs to Henry Chalfant and Martha Cooper and discusses documentation of throw-ups and burners.
source_records.next_action: Inspect individual story frames and record visible credits and item provenance.

source_records.title: National Gallery of Art — Henry Chalfant photographic works
source_records.evidence: NGA catalogue exposes 29 Chalfant works with dates, accession IDs, media and visual descriptions; selected works have individual records.
source_records.next_action: Use item pages as visual-analysis and provenance leads; obtain image permissions before embedding.
